about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (1 Kings 1:1–31) opens with King David “old and advanced in days,” the same words used of Abraham (Genesis 24:1). Like Abraham securing a wife for Isaac, the aged king acts to secure the line of the promised heir, Solomon. The reading from the Apostles (Galatians 4:21–31) returns to Sarah and Hagar. Shaul uses the son born according to the promise to teach Gentile believers that they too are children of promise, born free.
